claim: A short/long-distance and cyclic-clock equation improves completed-trip duration prediction in a reserved quarter against the frozen matched controls.
equation: See rules.json models.reference: T_hat=clip[a+bS min(d,3)+bL max(d-3,0)+cA A+cM M+u d sin(2pi h/24)+v d cos(2pi h/24),0,10000].
interpretation: A parsimonious phenomenological account of route mixtures and time-dependent congestion within this provider release.
falsification: Recorded distance is post-trip; only one city/year is tested. Negative airport offset, high residual errors and provider quality limitations exclude a universal speed or operational dispatch claim.

known_prior_art.known: Official trip dictionaries/zone lookup; provider-submitted records have no accuracy guarantee. Distance/time scaling and daily traffic cycles are established; no prospective routing benefit follows from post-trip distance prediction.

scope: Green-taxi2025 declared routine records, duration0–24h and distance0–1000km; known officialzones and source-month-consistent timestamps. Provider-reported records may contain errors; no congestion intervention, routing policy or achieved operational benefit.

claim: Simple distance proportionality and an operational pickup-time interpretation are inadequate for this task.
equation: Domain T=a+b*d and matched robust variant are retained; input availability excludes pickup-time use of actual trip distance.
interpretation: Better fitting needs route/time structure, but that structure remains observational and calibrated to the source cohort.
falsification: The causal and information-budget limits persist even where the numerical gain is strong; no prospective intervention was performed.
